executionNotes: 81 unique careers assembled from 3 deterministic disjoint shards plus a retained completed21-career refill prefix and corrected6-career suffix. Expensive bourbon scenarios wait for native cheapest-cask minimum plus£60 before starting; failed uncommitted fill attempt not adopted.
First54 candidate careers match old audit unscaled seed/cap/age/policy configurations; old216 results remain unchanged. Remaining27 are9mixed+12recipe/age/policy+6recipe/price.
Candidate supermarket minAge12 explicit sales guard was added during financial run; native qualified() already excludes those items, so executed financial input domain identical.

Added3 matched native careers: mixed policy until month36 naturally unlocks both shops; then best/worst destination or worst until48 then return to best. No synthetic contracts or funding. Total84 unique careers.
